baseline-public-routing.description: Public login traffic routed through the gateway with distributed client IPs so the public bucket does not dominate the latency profile.

authenticated-rate-limited-traffic.description: Single authenticated identity hitting the payment status route until the Redis-backed limiter starts returning 429s.

full-pipeline-normal.description: Protected order traffic with a pool of authenticated demo users to exercise auth, rate limiting, retry, load balancing, and healthy circuit breakers together.

circuit-breaker-transition-recovery.description: Payment route across healthy traffic, upstream failure, open-circuit fast rejection, and recovery after the breaker timeout.

phases.name: healthy-warmup
phases.description: Healthy upstream responses before inducing failures.

phases.name: failure-trip
phases.description: Forced 500s until the per-target breaker crosses the failure threshold.

phases.name: open-circuit
phases.description: Requests after the breaker opens and the gateway fast-rejects the dead upstream.

phases.name: recovery
phases.description: Reset chaos, wait past the breaker timeout, then confirm traffic succeeds again.
